name: Saimin Pet ~Mesu ni natta Watashi~
original_name: 催眠ペット～メスになったワタシ～
source:
Ginpachi runs a pet shop. He has no girlfriend (because he isn't, unfortunately, handsome), so just thinks about erotic things every day. But one day, his life suddenly changes dramatically after a book is sent to him from someone unknown.... It is a book on hypnotism. "I wish I could use hypnotism.... I would be able to control girls freely...? My dream would finally come true...?"

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090606090736/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/products_id/1012486]ErogeShop[/url]]
